metadata.description: Agents-On-Rails skills: one plugin per skill family, each versioned on its own.

plugins.name: aor-comm
plugins.description: Preview 0.x: communication skills for agents. Today one skill, aor-format-teams-message, which drafts a rich Microsoft Teams message and puts it on the Windows clipboard ready to paste.

plugins.name: aor-kb
plugins.description: Preview 0.x: evidence-graded knowledge-base skills for agents. Two skills: aor-kb-query, which searches a knowledge base and returns only claims that clear a trust grade, each stamped with its label; and aor-kb-capture, which records what a session learned as a graded claim behind a fail-closed employer-boundary guard.
